description: Search the Subframe Motion Library for React animation examples. Describe what you want in plain words — the effect, the element, how it should feel, or, when matching a screenshot, what it looks like and what moves ('glowing border sweeping around a dark pricing card', 'playful press feedback for a like button', 'calm shader background behind a headline'). Results come most relevant first, with how each one looks; call get_motion_example with a slug for its code. If nothing fits closely, the result says so. Search reads plain language but not negations, so put hard constraints in the filters (runtime react means no animation library). Leave the query empty to browse a category or runtime.

limit.description: How many examples to return. Ask for more when you want variety to choose from.

query.description: What you're looking for, in plain words. Omit to browse.

runtime.description: Only return examples built this way: react needs only React, motion also needs the motion package, webgl draws with WebGL.

name: search_motion_examples
title: Search Motion Examples
